question: I call setNumber(number + 1) three times in one click handler but the number only increases by one. Why, and how do I fix it?

question: My chat component's Effect re-connects to the server on every keystroke. Based on the docs, what is the likely cause and what are the suggested fixes?
acceptanceCriteria: Explains a documented cause of the Effect re-synchronizing on every keystroke — EITHER (a) the Effect has no dependency array, so it re-runs after every re-render, with the fix of adding a dependency array containing only the reactive values the Effect uses (e.g., roomId), OR (b) the Effect depends on a reactive value (or an object/function recreated every render) that changes on every keystroke, with fixes such as removing the value from dependencies by restructuring, or moving static values outside the component. Either scenario with its matching fix satisfies the criteria.
referenceAnswer: Two documented causes: (a) the Effect has no dependency array at all, so it re-synchronizes after every re-render — fix by adding a dependency array with only the reactive values it uses (e.g., [roomId]); or (b) the Effect depends on a reactive value or an object/function recreated on every render — fix by restructuring to remove it from dependencies or moving static values outside the component.
